purpose: Paired diagnostic panel for the official-interpretation card branch. It is not a canonical-policy selection set.
selection_contract: Includes every dev positive for v9 or v13, selected only after the official interpretation candidate was specified from DACON public guidance and the item table.
Also includes the frozen dev_fast_panel_v1 unchanged, preserving its broad positive, contract-law, and document-length coverage.
Dev labels are used only to make target-item evaluation adequately powered; no label, evidence, ID-specific condition, or historical prediction is used in either card or inference policy.
The exact ordered IDs are frozen before any EXP121 provider call. A favorable result requires an independent cohort before dev-200 confirmation.
